description: Create a user interview: AI persona participants complete tasks and answer questions against target_url, and results are synthesised into a report. target_url can be any reachable URL, including prototypes (Figma Make publish links, Claude design artifacts, v0) and preview deployments. Build the guide with add_interview_section / add_interview_item, add participants, then launch_interview.

name.description: Interview name shown in the dashboard, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. "Pricing page comprehension".

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects. The interview is filed under this project.

research_brief.description: What the team wants to learn; steers both the interviewer and the report. Omit to leave it blank.

target_url.description: Full URL participants start from, including the scheme, e.g. "https://staging.example.com/pricing".

usability_scale.description: Standardized usability questionnaire each participant answers after the guide: "umux" (four statements, comparable with SUS), "umux_lite" (two statements) or "none". get_interview_report then returns the round's score and grade. Defaults to "umux".

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: create_interview

id.description: Interview UUID, the interview_id the guide and participant tools take.

status.description: Interview status: draft, ready, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

usability_scale.description: Usability questionnaire participants answer after the guide: none, umux or umux_lite.

title: Create interview
